failure.trigger: First native M3 GPU submission from OpenGL or the compositor
failure.cause: Stock bindgen 0.73.1 generated incorrect task_struct field offsets; the initial build disabled layout assertions.

session_issue: The previous experimental Zink launcher refused the native GL prefix, and its fallback desktop correctly selected software rendering after the unconfirmed GPU attempt. A normal native session exposed the kernel fault.
disposition: Do not publish the unchecked kernel packages. Require corrected bindgen and unconditional layout assertions, a separate ABI, and fresh hardware qualification.
